question.text: What will Dabom's November 27, 2026 consumer price for a 30-egg pack of special-grade (특란) eggs in South Korea be?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves based on the daily consumer price (소비자가격) for special-grade eggs (특란, shown as the "XL" grade) in KRW per 30 eggs (원/30개) published on the Korea Institute for Animal Products Quality Evaluation's Dabom (축산유통정보) egg distribution-price page: https://www.ekapepia.com/v3/price/livestock/egg/distrPrice.do. The resolved value is the consumer-price figure in the page's daily table row dated 2026-11-27 (date label as displayed), reported in won as displayed — e.g. a displayed price of 7,354 resolves as 7,354. If no row dated 2026-11-27 is published in that table, the figure in the latest row dated before November 27, 2026 governs. If the Dabom page cannot be accessed, the consumer price for the November 26, 2026 trading day as reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used; if no value can be established, the question is annulled.
question.fine_print: The page reports prices in both 원/30개 (per 30 eggs) and 원/10개 (per 10 eggs); only the per-30-egg consumer price is used. Farm-gate (산지가격) and wholesale (도매가격) figures are not used. Row date labels are used exactly as displayed on the page; the underlying trading date (거래일자) of the November 27, 2026 row is irrelevant.

# Research brief: Dabom (KAPE) consumer price for a 30-egg XL carton, row dated 2026-11-27

## 1. Resolution source

In that row the XL consumer price is **7,243 won/30 eggs** (unchanged), farm-gate 5,039 (+64) and wholesale 5,481 (-133). Row labels are publication dates, about one business day after the trade, and only weekdays appear. 2026-11-27 is a Friday, so a row with that label should exist. [Dabom](https://www.ekapepia.com/v3/price/livestock/egg/distrPrice.do)

- Farm-gate price has drifted down from about 5,477 (Oct 19) to about 4,966-5,039 (Nov 9-16). Monthly farm-gate averages: Jul 6,768, Sep 6,295, Oct 5,487. The monthly table on the page lists only farm-gate and wholesale averages, not consumer.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. There are about 9 publication days left (Nov 17-27). The consumer price has been flat at 7,243 for three straight rows.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: An Asia Economy piece on food inflation mentions egg prices; there is no new figure beyond 7,243. [asiae](https://view.asiae.co.kr/article/2026111614582270477)
- 2026-11-13: H5N9 confirmed at a layer farm in Ganghwa (about 48,000 birds), the 4th poultry-farm case this winter. H5 antigen was also found at a Paju quail farm and a Jincheon breeder-duck farm. [agrinet](https://www.agrinet.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=408835)
- I found no layer-farm confirmations for Nov 14-17 in my searches. A nationwide disinfection week runs Nov 4-17.
- 2026-11-11: The Korea Layer Association put farm-gate at 4,800-5,000 won against the 7,354 consumer price (a 53% gap) and asked for a probe of distribution margins. The agriculture ministry says AI culls total about 430,000 birds, roughly 0.5% of a record flock of 84.01 million. It forecasts November output of 50.59 million eggs a day (+2.3% y/y) and continued falls in farm-gate prices. [chuksannews](https://www.chuksannews.co.kr/news/article.html?no=274452)
- 2026-11-08: Media reported 7,354 won, up 8.2% week on week, after the AI outbreaks. [newneek](https://newneek.co/@newneek/article/48519), [fnnews](https://www.fnnews.com/news/202611080801418181)
- 2026-11-07: The Yeoju layer farm (about 260,000 birds) was confirmed and fully culled by Nov 8. [imaeil](https://www.imaeil.com/page/view/2026110719461426685)
- 2026-10-23: Farms were building up stock and the supply-demand index for special-grade eggs showed oversupply. Herald gave an October average of 6,905; this differs slightly from the 6,868 in the question background. [Herald](https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10912265)

## 4. Base rates
- Daily step changes seen recently: +274, -204, +46, -51, -60, +211, +123, +356, -111. The price often stays flat for 3-7 rows at a time.
- Over windows of about 9 publication days since Oct 19, the net move ranged from about -200 to +700 (Oct 19 to Nov 5). Over a comparable span starting Oct 22, the move was about +65.
- Seasonal comparison:
  - 2025: the October average was 7,039 and the November average 6,499 (-7.7%), even with a layer-farm AI case in mid-November. Reports say prices sat in the 6,000s from late November into early December and climbed sharply from late December. [economist.co.kr](https://economist.co.kr/article/view/ecn202512250017)
  - One article attributes the 6,499 figure to aT/KAMIS rather than KAPE.
  - I could not find exact KAPE daily values for Nov 17 to Nov 27 in 2025 or earlier years.
  - This year's level of 7,243 is running about 10% above the November 2025 average.
- Retail prices are sticky compared with the falling farm-gate price: the consumer-to-farm-gate spread is now about 2,200 won, against about 1,180 won on Oct 19.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no market on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus about Korean egg prices. The Kalshi "Egg prices up in November?" market (59% Yes) refers to US CPI eggs, so it is not relevant.
- Expert outlook: the agriculture ministry and the Korea Rural Economic Institute (KREI) expect falling farm-gate prices in November. KREI says farm-gate fell 2.3% from late October (1,721 won/10 eggs) to early November (1,682). [supple](https://supple.kr/news/cmwj1ysab2bx5jkundwn03pan), [Google search summary](https://www.greened.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=342757)
- No one publishes a point forecast for the consumer price.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- New AI cases in layer farms are the main upside risk. 24-hour movement standstills can disrupt trading, and the page notes that blank cells mean no trades because of standstill orders.
- Kimjang (kimchi-making) season and year-end demand: kimchi-making costs are at a 10-year low, which points to soft food inflation in general. [yna](https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20261114032700030)
- The government's 20% discount on domestic produce runs Nov 1 to Dec 4. It is unclear whether it covers eggs. [mk](https://www.mk.co.kr/news/business/12209834)
- The Fair Trade Commission margin dispute and possible hypermarket egg promotions could push the surveyed retail price down.
- KREI's December livestock outlook would normally come out in late November; I did not find a release date.
- Weather is not a direct driver, so I looked up no weather forecast.
